versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the discussion-grammar-diagnosis skill.
- Diagnoses tense choice, subject-verb agreement, article usage, voice consistency, and punctuation in the Discussion section of English psychology research papers.
- Focus on tense–claim alignment, tense consistency, and move-by-move tense auditing.
- Does not generate or rewrite prose; provides diagnostic feedback only.
- Activated by triggers such as "check Discussion tense", "grammar check", "tense diagnosis", and similar queries.
